column3: “Your” is supplied; being put to death renders die the death.
“Devoted to God” supplies a recipient for gift.
“Need not” renders will certainly not; mother and with it are supplied.
Of the blind is omitted after guides.
“Yet” is supplied; the latrine is omitted.
“To Him” supplies the direction of approaching.
“Jesus” specifies He; dogs omits the diminutive.
“Dogs” omits the diminutive; master is singular instead of plural.
